_comment: Hand-kept, reviewed in PRs. Component placements that ds/placement warns on: which components inside which slot or container belong to a different pattern, what to use instead, and the ds guide topic to read.

placements.message: in a Section's toolbar is a form or view-switch control, not a view-bar filter
placements.fix: use FilterButton (1–3 quick filters; pass trigger={<FilterButton … />} to PopupSelect) or FilterMenu (staged multi-category menu); run `ds guide filtering`
